summary: Sang-ri Yi joined the organizing committee for the [NHERI Computational Symposium 2026](https://simcenter.designsafe-ci.org/nheri-computational-symposium/2026/) at UC Berkeley.
summaryParagraphs: Sang-ri Yi joined the organizing committee for the [NHERI Computational Symposium 2026](https://simcenter.designsafe-ci.org/nheri-computational-symposium/2026/) at UC Berkeley.
Sang-ri will also attend [SIAM-UQ26](https://www.siam.org/conferences-events/siam-conferences/uq26/) and [ICCE 2026](https://www.icce2026.com/) next year.
